xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4934: Agent MCP and bots (W-INJ3): ACP harnesses (acp, opencode)

plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-INJ3): ACP harnesses (acp, opencode)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Claude Code agents get the `overdeck` MCP server since PAN-4932, but agents on the ACP harnesses (`acp` = Kimi Code over ACP, `opencode` = OpenCode over ACP) get nothing. The ACP host sends `mcpServers` in `session/new` and `session/load`, but the field is always `[]`: the host has no flag for it, `buildAcpCommand` ignores `overdeckMcpConfig`, `prepareClaudeOverdeckMcp` returns `{}` for every launch kind but `claude-code`, and both ACP harnesses declare `overdeckMcp: false`.
narratives.Proposal: Reuse W-INJ1's per-owner `overdeck-mcp.json`. Every ACP launch site already spreads `prepareClaudeOverdeckMcp` with the real harness, so: (1) declare `overdeckMcp: true` for `acp` and `opencode`; (2) widen the helper's launch-kind guard to the closed set {claude-code, acp-host}; (3) `buildAcpCommand` passes `--mcp-config <path>` to the host; (4) a new leaf `src/lib/acp/mcp-config.ts` converts the file's stdio entries to ACP `McpServerStdio` (`env` as `{name,value}[]`, no `type`) and degrades to `[]` with one stderr line; (5) the host parses `--mcp-config` and passes `mcpServers` to `makeRuntime`, which already forwards it to `session/new` and `session/load`. A planning probe showed opencode 1.18.31 and kimi 2.0.2 spawn a stdio server and call `tools/list` on both requests; CP-3 then verifies the real path end to end and records it in `configuration/harnesses.mdx`.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Renaming `prepareClaudeOverdeckMcp` or `writeClaudeOverdeckMcpConfig` (PRD D-1)
- Codex injection (W-INJ2, PAN-4933)
- The MCP/CLI instructions blocks in the ACP launch context (W-INJ4)
- Provisioning role-declared `mcpServers` (Playwright etc.) for ACP harnesses
- The ACP `http` or `sse` MCP transports; stdio only, so no token enters an ACP payload
- `kimi-code` (native TUI), `ohmypi`, `muse`, `prime-agent`
- Changing `OPENCODE_PRE_ALLOWED_PERMISSION` unless CP-3 shows a main-session hang
- A committed live-probe test or probe script
- Editing any launch call site (spawn.ts, spawn-prep.ts, conversation-runtime.ts, recovery.ts, messaging.ts, spawn-planning-session.ts, routes/misc/planning.ts)
- Putting the agent token, or any secret, in argv, the launcher, the MCP config or an ACP payload

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the names `prepareClaudeOverdeckMcp` and `writeClaudeOverdeckMcpConfig`; update the header comment to say the file is Claude Code's --mcp-config format and the ACP host reads it.
autoDecisions.rationale: A rename touches 8 call sites in 7 files that W-INJ2 (PAN-4933) will also edit, for no behavior change; 'Claude' names the file format, which stays accurate.

autoDecisions.summary: Widen the helper's guard to a closed set OVERDECK_MCP_JSON_LAUNCH_KINDS = {claude-code, acp-host}, not a check of the capability alone.
autoDecisions.rationale: Codex (W-INJ2) needs config.toml tables, not this JSON, so the guard must list only the launch kinds whose command builders read overdeckMcpConfig.

autoDecisions.summary: No change to getAcpLauncherFields or any launch call site (epic file list corrected, PRD C-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: W-INJ1 already spreads the helper into every ACP launch config with the real harness (spawn-prep, spawn, planning, conversation-runtime; recovery via buildAgentLaunchConfig).

autoDecisions.summary: Stdio transport only; the ACP http transport is not used even though both agents advertise it.
autoDecisions.rationale: http would put the token in a header inside the ACP session/new payload, which protocol capture and agent logs record (epic NFR-2).

autoDecisions.summary: The JSON-to-ACP conversion lives in a new leaf module src/lib/acp/mcp-config.ts; host.ts grows by at most 6 lines.
autoDecisions.rationale: Unit-testable without spawning the host; host.ts is 915 lines.

autoDecisions.summary: A missing, unreadable or malformed config file makes the host log one stderr line and start with no MCP servers.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches W-INJ1's never-throw degrade rule: losing the tools must never block an agent start.

autoDecisions.summary: ACP tests go in src/lib/acp/__tests__/, not the epic's tests/unit/lib/acp/host-mcp-servers.test.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every existing ACP test lives there (host, session-runtime, permissions, providers).

autoDecisions.summary: CP-3 fallback is per harness (kimi -> acp, opencode/opencode-go -> opencode), and opencode-go is covered by the opencode check.
autoDecisions.rationale: harnessGetsOverdeckMcp reads a per-harness capability (PAN-4932 C-2); opencode and opencode-go share one binary and support object, and session/new carries no model.

autoDecisions.summary: Declare overdeckMcp: true for both acp and opencode in the first item, before the live check.
autoDecisions.rationale: The planning probe showed opencode 1.18.31 and kimi 2.0.2 spawn a stdio server and call tools/list on session/new and session/load; CP-3 can still set a harness back to false.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not change OPENCODE_PRE_ALLOWED_PERMISSION; CP-3 checks main-session and Task-subagent tool calls and documents a subagent hang as a limitation.
autoDecisions.rationale: The ACP host auto-approves main-session permission asks; widening pre-allowed keys also overrides an operator's own deny (concerns.md, PAN-3937).

autoDecisions.summary: The CP-3 probe script is not committed; its result goes into configuration/harnesses.mdx and the PR description.
autoDecisions.rationale: A live test needs installed binaries, auth and a model turn; a skipIf-guarded test would trip the test-skip gate.

narrative.Action: PRD W-4. Create src/lib/acp/mcp-config.ts (under 80 lines, double-quote style like the other src/lib/acp files) with header 'PAN-4927 W-INJ3 (PAN-4934): read the overdeck MCP config (Claude Code --mcp-config format) and convert its stdio servers to ACP McpServerStdio entries for session/new and session/load.' Export `async function readAcpMcpServers(path: string, warn: (line: string) => void = (line) => console.error(line)): Promise<EffectAcpSchema.McpServerStdio[]>` using `readFile` from node:fs/promises and `import type * as EffectAcpSchema from "effect-acp/schema"`. Rules (PRD D-5, D-6): each `mcpServers` entry whose `type` is 'stdio' or absent and whose `command` is a non-empty string becomes `{ name: <key>, command, args: <string[] or []>, env: Object.entries(env ?? {}).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value: String(value) })) }` with no `type` key, in file order; any other type or a missing command is skipped with one warn line `[acp-host] MCP server <name> skipped: <reason>`; a read error, invalid JSON or a top level without an `mcpServers` object returns [] with one warn line `[acp-host] overdeck MCP config skipped: <reason>`. Never throws, no *Sync call, no Effect wrapper. Create src/lib/acp/__tests__/mcp-config.test.ts with a mkdtemp dir and a warn spy covering: the W-INJ1 overdeck shape (type stdio, three env keys) converts to one entry with name 'overdeck', the same command/args, env as three {name,value} pairs and no type; an entry without type converts the same and absent args/env become []; an http entry and a command-less entry are skipped with one warning each while a stdio sibling survives; a missing file, invalid JSON and {} each return [] with exactly one warning.

narrative.Action: PRD W-6 (epic AC-5). After `npm run build`, write an uncommitted probe under `.tmp/` run with `npx tsx` and OVERDECK_HOME=$(mktemp -d): call ensureAgentMcpToken({ agentId: 'cp3-probe', agentKind: 'agent', role: 'work', dir }) and writeClaudeOverdeckMcpConfig(dir, tokenFile) from src/lib/mcp/, then readAcpMcpServers(<config>). For each binary — `opencode acp --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port <free port>` and `kimi acp` — speak ACP over stdio: initialize, authenticate ('opencode-login'; Kimi: the method resolveKimiAuthMethodId picks), session/new { cwd, mcpServers }, then session/prompt 'List the names of every tool you have from the overdeck MCP server. Reply with the names only.' and collect agent_message_chunk text. Pass for a provider: the reply contains `list_conversations`; also record that a `dist/cli/index.js mcp serve` process ran as a child of the agent (`ps -o pid,ppid,args --ppid <agent pid>`). Permission check on opencode: prompt 'Call the overdeck list_machines tool and tell me how many machines it returned.' (must finish within 120 s, AbortController + setTimeout), then 'Use the task tool to start a subagent that calls the overdeck list_machines tool and reports the count.' (must finish within 180 s). Decision rule: a provider whose agent rejects or ignores the entry => set that harness's overdeckMcp to false (kimi -> acp, opencode -> opencode) and update the acp-capability-flag test set; a failure from missing auth or exhausted quota is not a fallback: record 'not verified live: <reason>' and keep the capability; a subagent hang => do not change OPENCODE_PRE_ALLOWED_PERMISSION, record it as a known limitation. Write the outcome (binary versions, pass/fail per provider and per step, exact errors) into configuration/harnesses.mdx section '### Overdeck MCP server' under a paragraph 'ACP harnesses (PAN-4934)' and into the PR description. Never commit the probe.
